title: GridSim v2 template library (gridsim-library/2)
description: A file of fixed, standardised templates. The placeholder rules are enforced here with if/then/else: a placeholder template has every parameter and controller value null, an active one has none null. Rules that span templates or need the kind spec (a placeholder may not be a controller target, a controller ref must resolve to a template of the slot's kind, params checked against the kind's units and ranges, id@rev unique, per-parameter provenance keys naming real parameters) cannot be expressed in this schema subset and are enforced in code by V2LibraryChecker.

then.description: A placeholder: every parameter value and every controller slot is null.

else.description: An active template: no parameter value and no controller slot is null (leave a key out instead).

controllers.title: Controller slots
controllers.description: References to the exciter, PSS and governor templates this template uses. Each slot's target must be a template of the same-named kind (exciter, pss, governor) and must not be a placeholder (checked in code).

templateProvenance.title: Template provenance
templateProvenance.description: The template's _default provenance (required) plus optional per-parameter entries keyed by parameter name, as in v1 asset-classes.json.
